highlights.title: Stop stops the whole team
highlights.text: When you stop a teammate, the team stops with it. Nothing restarts the work on its own, and a teammate that was waiting shows Stopped, not Failed.

highlights.title: Add-ons reach a busy teammate
highlights.text: If you add something while a teammate is still working, it no longer gets lost. It waits its turn and starts as soon as their current task is done.

highlights.title: See when a teammate waits for you
highlights.text: When a teammate needs your OK or asked you a question, its card in the team chat says so, with a Go to it button, instead of a spinner that says it is still working.

fixes: A teammate whose model stops without answering now says so in plain words, with what to do next.
Line chart dates no longer overlap on tablets and medium-width windows.
